text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka got injured, so I took her 
to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm sorry for causing you so much 
trouble...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, the pain has mostly subsided. I 
believe it should be fine as long as I 
rest quietly.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um, I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
If only I had been more careful, this 
wouldn't have happened...
choice_data_list: For now, just take it slow and rest.
For now, take it slow and get some rest.

Let's get better soon and get back to 
training!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
If only I had been more careful, this 
wouldn't have happened...
choice_data_list: For now, just take it slow and rest.
For now, take it slow and get some rest.

Let's get better soon and get back to 
training!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Though my legs might get a little 
bored...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*... I already miss the feel of the 
turf...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, I have a suggestion... I've heard that 
light exercise can actually help you rest.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
How about going for a light, easy jog as 
part of your rehab...!
choice_data_list:
As long as you don't push yourself too 
hard, sure!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll be careful. I think I'll run 
while keeping an eye on how things go."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*... Looks like it'll still take a 
while to get back in top form...

The light jog meant for rehabilitation 
placed too much strain on her, and Silence 
Suzuka's full recovery ended up delayed...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Looks like she's getting into top 
shape, too.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
With this, I should be able to get back to 
training right away...!

The light jog meant for rehabilitation 
paid off, and Silence Suzuka recovered her 
form sooner than expected.
